definitions.explanation: A period of history from the distant past, typically before the medieval period.

examples.japanese: {古代|こだい}⟦ギリシャ→ギリシャ：28897_girisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧
{古代|こだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発掘|はっくつ}する→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧。
{古代|こだい}⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: To study the history of ancient Japan.

notes:
{古代|こだい} refers to the earliest period of recorded history. In Japanese historiography, it typically covers the period up to around the 12th century (before the ⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧).

JAPANESE HISTORICAL PERIODS:
- {古代|こだい}: ancient (up to ~12th century)
- ⟦{中世|ちゅうせい}→中世：05524_chuusei⟧: medieval (~12th-16th century)
- ⟦{近世|きんせい}→近世：14399_kinsei⟧: early modern (~16th-19th century)
- ⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧: modern (Meiji onwards)
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧: contemporary

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古代|こだい}⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧: ancient civilization
- {古代|こだい}⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧: ancient ruins
- {古代|こだい}⟦{史|し}→史：noentry⟧: ancient history
- {古代|こだい}⟦ギリシャ→ギリシャ：28897_girisha⟧: ancient Greece
- {古代|こだい}⟦エジプト→エジプト：noentry⟧: ancient Egypt

USAGE:
Also functions as a no-adjective: {古代|こだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧ (ancient people).
